QuestInfo.name: [Choco Onslaught] Enter the Chocopocalypse
QuestInfo.0: It's Valentine's Day! A holiday overflowing with chocolate, flowers, and professions of love! Yet, Cassandra seems lonely. Perhaps you should speak with her?
QuestInfo.1: It's Valentine's Day! A holiday overflowing with chocolate, flowers, and professions of love! Except if what Cassandra says is true, it's really an evil conspiracy. She asks you to save Maple World by eating all of its chocolate before the people become enslaved by chocolatey goodness.
